questions.prompt_en: The table shows the weekly hours spent on three leisure activities by two age groups in a fictional town in 2025. Summarise the main features and compare the groups. Write at least 150 words.
questions.prompt_vi: Distinguish hours from percentages; give an overview and compare groups.

answer.model_en:
The table compares the number of hours that two age groups in a town spent on three leisure activities each week in 2025. The figures cover watching online video, exercising and reading for pleasure.

Overall, younger adults spent more time watching online videos, whereas older adults devoted more hours to reading. The difference between the groups was much smaller for exercise than for the other activities.

People aged 18 to 29 watched online videos for 12 hours a week, which was five hours more than the figure for those aged 50 to 64. Online video was also the most time-consuming activity for the younger group. By comparison, older adults spent seven hours on it, making this their second most popular activity.

For reading, the pattern was reversed. The older group read for eight hours weekly, compared with only three hours among younger adults. Exercise accounted for five hours in the younger group and four hours in the older group. Thus, exercise showed the smallest difference, at just one hour per week.
